items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Did you know Frankie Dooson? Oh, yes, sir, man. Well, he was a wonderful, uh, uh, what's it called, uh, rotina.

ctx.x: I saw his wife, uh, Friday. You did? She lives right around the corner from the Tulane Club. Yeah. I gotta go back and see her sometime. She seemed like a very nice lady. Yes, ma'am. I was getting in the car with a trombone player, Clement Tervalon, and she said, my husband used to play that instrument. Yeah. Willie Connish's wife. Willie Connish's wife. Just, just by being with a trombone player, I found her. Oh, uh. I was with, uh, this fella, Clement Tervalon. He works with Clement Tervalon. He's Burbank's…

Oh, on the street back. Yeah. Did you know Frankie Dooson? Oh, yes, sir, man. Well, he was a wonderful, uh, uh, what's it called, uh, rotina. Mm-hmm. He was a rotina Frankie Dooson. Tall, brown, silver. Well, where was he from?
All right, right across the room. Mm-hmm. Um, a motor room. And who did he work with?
